top.line: The AgentiCCells partner programme: three kinds of partner, the team they resell, the rules of engagement.

in-short.line: Partners not competitors; three kinds; the cell and its team; 50/50; customer owns; partner runs it after.

why.line: Partners have the relationships, we have the factory; a partner who goes alone is still a win.

types.line: The freelancer, the small consultancy, the larger firm, each with its own reason to sell this.

team.line: Even the smallest cell is a conductor, researcher, designer, developer and security reviewer.
team.para: That team is what partners resell.

flow.line: Find, material, set up, designs, hand-over, after: six steps, the partner owning the relationship.

rules.line: 50/50 when I orchestrate; whoever has the customer invoices; subscriptions are the partner's; customer owns the site.

anywhere.line: Any country, any language; the partner invoices in their own currency and law.

packages.line: Next: packages for products, a cell per product such as Odoo or WordPress.

ask.line: Which of the three are you? The first partners shape the rules.

limits.line: No partner signed; nothing sold; payment terms a proposal.

sources.line: Dinis's briefs of 17 November 2026, the AgentiCCells strategy and earlier articles.
